sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.content: Attention Is All You Need introduced the Transformer architecture. The model relies on attention mechanisms instead of recurrent or convolutional sequence modeling layers. Self-attention models token relationships within a sequence in parallel and offers shorter paths than recurrent encoder-decoder processing.

claims.text: The Transformer architecture was introduced in the paper 'Attention Is All You Need'.

sources.title: LoRA Method Paper
sources.content: LoRA trains low-rank adapter weights while the base model weights remain frozen, reducing trainable parameters and memory use. Full fine-tuning updates all base model weights and requires more optimizer state, memory, and checkpoint storage.

sources.title: LoRA Task Comparison
sources.content: The task-specific comparison table shows that adaptation quality can differ by task and model; a parameter-efficient method should be validated on the target evaluation set.

claims.text: LoRA is preferable when memory or trainable-parameter budget is constrained because it trains low-rank adapter weights rather than updating all base model weights.

evidence.quote_or_summary: LoRA trains low-rank adapter weights while the base model weights remain frozen, reducing trainable parameters and memory use.

claims.text: Full fine-tuning can offer maximum task-specific flexibility but requires substantially more optimizer state, memory, and checkpoint storage.

sources.title: Python tomllib Documentation
sources.content: The tomllib module reads TOML data. tomllib.load reads TOML from a binary file object, and tomllib.loads parses a string. The module is intended for parsing TOML configuration files.

sources.title: Vector ANN Index Documentation
sources.content: Approximate nearest neighbor vector indexes retrieve semantically similar embeddings. They trade exactness or recall for faster search over high-dimensional vectors.

sources.title: BM25 Retrieval Reference
sources.content: BM25 is a probabilistic retrieval function that ranks documents using lexical term matching, term frequency, and document statistics rather than embedding distance.

sources.title: BM25 Search Documentation
sources.content: Search engine BM25 ranking uses lexical term statistics and matches query tokens; it does not calculate embedding similarity.

sources.title: Hybrid Retrieval Evaluation
sources.content: The retrieval comparison shows complementary lexical and semantic behavior. Hybrid retrieval or reranking can help when queries mix semantic intent with exact identifiers.
